evidence.evidence_text: Nowadays, the omnipresence of the Internet has fostered a subculture that congregates around the contemporary milieu.
The subculture artfully articulates the intricacies of human feelings by ardently pursuing the allure of novelty, a fact that cannot be disregarded in the sentiment analysis.

To this end, a new approach of subculture-based data augmentation (SCDA) is proposed, which engenders enhanced texts for each training text by leveraging the creation of specific subcultural expression generators.
